title: In vitro differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into the B lineage using OP9-MS5 co-culture
protocol: Overgrow OP9 cultures.
On day 4 after seeding remove 5 mL of media from OP9 plates and replace with 5 mL fresh, warm OP9-M media.
Prepare hPSCs for harvest by passing them 3–5 days in advance of harvest at such a density as to provide large undifferentiated colonies.
Harvest hPSCs as whole colonies using collagenase.
Aim to harvest between 1.5-2×10^6 hPSCs (1–3 wells of a 6 well plate) per 10 cm dish of OP9.
Prepare fresh collagenase IV solution in DMEM/F12 basal media and warm to 37°C.
Remove StemFit media and replace with 1 mL of warmed collagenase IV.
Incubate at 37°C for 30–90 minutes until colonies start to detach.
Gently wash whole hPSC colonies/clumps from the well into a 50 mL conical tube using a serological pipette with OP9-D media.
Wash colonies 3 times in 10 mL OP9-D media by gravity alone.
Resuspend colonies in 5 mL OP9-D media and transfer to an overgrown OP9 plate using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Gently swirl the plate, remove all media and hPSC cell debris, then replace with 20 mL OP9-D media on Day 1.
Exchange 10 mL off/on OP9-D media on Day 4.
Exchange 10 mL off/on OP9-D media on Day 6.
Exchange 10 mL off/on OP9-D media on Day 8.
Pre-gelatinize the required number of wells of a 6 well plate for at least 2 hours prior to seeding MS5.
Harvest and count MS5 cells as per maintenance protocol.
Seed up to 2×105 MS5 cells per well of a 6 well plate in MS5-M media.
Disassociate OP9-hPSC co-culture by collagenase and trypsin digest on day 10.
Prepare and warm fresh collagenase IV and trypsin according to the description in Materials and Equipment section.
Remove all media from the OP9-hPSC plate to a 50 mL conical tube on ice.
Pellet any non-adherent cells in the used media by centrifugation at 300g for 5min and discard supernatant if more than one plate is being harvested.
Add 7 mL warmed collagenase IV 1 mg/mL in DMEM/F12 and incubate at 37°C for 25 min.
Gently swirl the collagenase to wash off residual serum-containing media.
Carefully remove and discard collagenase, avoiding losing cellular material or detaching the stromal layer.
Add 7 mL freshly prepared 0.05% trypsin/5 mM EDTA.
Score the stromal matrix orthogonally into approximately 1 cm² sections using a 1 mL micropipette tip.
Incubate at 37°C.
Agitate the plate intermittently during incubation to facilitate trypsin exposure to the underside of the stromal layer.
Use a 10 mL serological pipette to titrate the stroma after 3-7 minutes.
Quench trypsin with 7 mL OP9-D media.
Further titrate with a 1 mL pipette to break up clumps.
Collect the cellular material into the 50 mL conical tube through a 40-70 μm nylon filter (pre-wetted with MACS buffer).
Wash the plate with 5 mL MACS buffer and add to 50 mL conical tube through the 40-70 μm nylon filter.
Wash the filter twice with 1 mL MACS buffer.
Discard the filter and pellet cells by centrifugation at 300 g for 5 min.
Resuspend cell pellet in 300 μL chilled MACS buffer.
Incubate with 100 μL Fc receptor block for 5 min on ice.
Add 100 μL anti-CD34 MACS beads and incubate at 4°C for 30 min on a rotator.
Load Miltenyi LS MACS column into magnet holder, insert 30-50 μm sterile filter and place over a collection tube/reservoir.
Prime column with 3 mL of chilled MACS buffer.
Incubate the prepared cells.
Wash cells with 5 mL chilled MACS buffer, centrifuge at 300 g 4°C for 5 min.
Resuspend cell pellet in 500 μL chilled MACS buffer and add to MACS LS column through the cell strainer.
Wash column with 3 mL chilled MACS buffer until dripping stops.
Repeat wash step two more times, discarding wash solution after each.
Remove column from magnet, discard strainer.
Extract cells by applying 5 mL chilled MACS buffer and rapid plunging into fresh 15 mL conical tube.
Repeat extraction once more with 3 mL buffer to increase yield of CD34+ cells.
Centrifuge enriched cells at 300 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the CD34-enriched pellet in 0.5 mL OP9-D media.
Count cells using a hemocytometer counterstained with Trypan blue.
Exclude dead (blue) or very large, phase-bright stromal cells from the cell count estimation.
Assess day 10 intermediate progenitors carefully when establishing this protocol.
Check for the presence of a small population of CD34+CD45RA+IL7R+ progenitors at day 10.
Take an aliquot of the CD34-enriched fraction for staining.
Stain according to protocol below (step 15).
Prepare sufficient OP9-D media with 2× final cytokine concentrations for the number of CD34 cells harvested.
Remove MS5-M media from a 6 well plate.
Add 1 mL per well of 2× cytokine-containing OP9-D media to MS5 on a 6 well plate.
Dilute the CD34+ cell pellet to add 12.5–50×10^3 CD34-enriched cells per well of MS5 in 1 mL OP9-D media.
Add diluted CD34 cells to wells containing MS5, resulting in a final volume of 2 mL/well with 1× cytokine concentration.
On day 17 of culture (day 7 on MS5), add 2 mL OP9-D media containing 1× cytokines: hIL7 20 ng/mL, hFlt3L 50 ng/mL, hSCF 50 ng/mL.

On day 24 of culture (day 14 on MS5), carefully remove up to 2 mL of media, accounting for evaporation, and replace with fresh OP9-D media supplemented with 1× cytokines: hIL7 20 ng/mL, hFlt3L 50 ng/mL, hSCF 50 ng/mL.
Replace media on day 24 to ensure a final volume of 4 mL/well with 1× cytokine concentration (excluding IL-3).
Take media from the edge of the well containing non-adherent hematopoietic cells if visible.
Centrifuge the media at 300g for 5 min and reseed the pellet into the initial well in fresh OP9-D media supplemented with cytokines.
Harvest cells on day 31 (27–33) of culture for analysis.
Use a cell scraper to mechanically detach stroma and titurate with a 1 ml micropipette into a single cell suspension.
Centrifuge cells at 300 g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 50 μL Fc receptor block.
Incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Mix equal volume of 2× concentrated antibody staining cocktail and Fc receptor blocked cells.
Stain in the dark on a shaker for 40 min at 4°C.
Wash with 1 mL of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min.
Resuspend in MACS buffer containing 1× viability dye.
Set up the flow cytometry with single stained beads.
Stain cells with only viability marker.
Harvest cells after 3 weeks of MS5 co-culture.
Gated cells for singlets and scatter.
Gated for viability (7AAD) and CD45 expression.
Expressed CD19 and CD34 within the 7AAD-CD45+ fraction.
Further gated CD19 positive fraction for expression of CD10 and CD20.
Gated for B lymphoid markers within the CD19- gate.
Stained for myeloid (CD11b and CD14) markers.
